title: Implement context warning and blocking-limit state
objective: Replace the simple Go context bar thresholding with TS-equivalent warning, error, auto-compact, and blocking-limit calculations.
implementation_scope: Add CalculateTokenWarningState with percentLeft, warning threshold, error threshold, auto-compact threshold, and blocking limit.
Respect auto-compact enabled/disabled state when selecting threshold basis.
Reserve manual compact buffer when auto-compact is disabled.
Implement compact warning suppression after microcompact or full compact success.
Update context UI/command display to reflect warning state rather than fixed 50/80 percent color cutoffs.
Add pre-call blocking behavior only when automatic recovery paths are disabled, matching TS semantics.
out_of_scope: Do not redesign the TUI layout.
Do not implement auto-compact itself; consume task_08 interfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover warning, error, auto-compact, blocking, auto-disabled, and post-compact suppression cases.
No synthetic blocking error is emitted when reactive compact or context-collapse recovery should own real provider overflow.
Context display uses the effective input window after output-token reservation.
risks: UI state must stay consistent with query-loop compaction decisions.
Over-eager blocking can prevent reactive recovery from firing.
dispatch_prompt: Implement TS-equivalent context warning/blocking state in Go and wire it into context UI and query preflight behavior.
